title: VESPER Telemetry Record
description: SR-011: 'records model, context, response time, tokens, RAM, GPU, CPU, quality notes; VISIBLE TO THE MODEL AND ACTIONABLE'. That pairing is a hazard as well as a requirement -- a model-visible value that directly actuates a governor is a control loop a model can drive. This schema carries the values; DF-GOVERNOR-LEVEL is the damped path that consumes them; CI-039 forbids the direct path. Authority: SR-011, SR-026, SR-057; REM-012 §6; INV-OBS-1/2, INV-PERF-1, INV-HW-2.

correlation_id.description: INV-OBS-2: purge removes payloads; the event SKELETON and this correlation chain survive. A privacy deletion must not destroy the ability to reconstruct that something happened.

sensitivity.description: INV-OBS-1: sensitivity is enforced AT WRITE TIME by the telemetry writer, never by caller discipline. `secret_excluded` is not a permission to store a secret -- it marks a record from which secret-bearing fields were structurally removed before the write.

stage.description: Matches the stage ids in contracts/policy/latency_budgets.toml, so a measured record can be compared against its budget without a mapping table that could drift.

measurement.description: Normalised 0..1 pressure values, so DF-GOVERNOR-LEVEL is comparable across heterogeneous nodes without naming any of them (INV-HW-1). Every field is nullable because a node genuinely may not expose it -- and a null means UNMEASURED, which DF-GOVERNOR-LEVEL treats as absent rather than as zero.

source.description: INV-HW-2. A telemetry value is MEASURED. `derived` marks a computed aggregate and may never be used where a measured value is required -- notably, never to populate a NodeCapabilityProfile field.

quality_note.description: SR-011's 'quality notes'. Free text is acceptable HERE and nowhere else in this corpus, because this field is an observation about an interaction rather than an input to a decision. DF-GOVERNOR-LEVEL does not read it.

model_visible.description: SR-011 requires telemetry to be visible to the model. Visible means READABLE. It does not mean ACTIONABLE-BY-WRITING: there is no field on this record through which a model can request a governor level, and CI-039 fails any code path in which a model-visible value actuates a level change without traversing DF-GOVERNOR-LEVEL's damping.

decided_by.description: One permitted value. A governor level attributed to anything else -- a model, a heuristic at a call site, an operator override without a record -- is unrecordable, which is the schema-level form of CI-039.

owner_confirmation_required.description: SR-057: forced closure of the owner's applications REQUIRES ASKING. YIELD while the owner has a foreground application active sets this true and does NOT apply the level.

then.$comment: A record that may later be purged must be correlatable, or INV-OBS-2's surviving skeleton has nothing to hang on.
A governor level may only be actuated from a MEASURED record. Actuating from a derived aggregate is how a smoothed average ends up hiding the spike that mattered.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: any field carrying a credential, token, key, prompt body or retrieved content. Provider credentials are the highest-value target on the network, and telemetry is the least-guarded store in any system. Enforcement is at the writer (INV-OBS-1), not at the caller: `additionalProperties: false` means a caller cannot smuggle a field through, and the writer strips before the write rather than trusting the caller to have done so.
